task: ADR-036 (Learning Methodology Examples, Best-Practice Ledger and the Review-Triage Learning Loop): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Decides an example catalog (32 entries, class derived from Ideation state), a best-practice ledger adopted only on real episodes, and a staged review-triage loop, with no new LearningStore record type (ADR-002), no change to a methodology state (ADR-024), no learned authority over accept or decline (ADR-001, ADR-003 Invariant 6, ADR-008 Invariant 4), and consistent with the selection skill and HYP-AL-002.
Five alternatives evaluated and rejected with real reasons: runnable examples for all 32, prose only, training a triage policy now, a new record type, and auto-accepting high-reliability findings.

Discloses the benefits (visible limits per methodology, an honest practice ledger, learning from the build loop at no cost in autonomy) and the costs (19 example directories, a fixed-shape record per finding, residual risk that synthetic examples are misread, weak reliability evidence at small counts).

Bounds the open items in Section 8 (the routing policy tier, generating the catalog state, other reviewers, trace_id, ledger vs lessons learned) and records that the real review data is small and nearly all accepted, and that the author of the code also triages it.
